meta_description: Armitage Plumbing Solutions in Bolton. Emergency repairs, boiler installations, and burst pipe specialists. Fast response times, no call-out charge. Call now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 2am in Bolton? We arrive in under an hour, every time. Call now for same-day repairs.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing Services Across Greater Bolton
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to scheduled boiler servicing, we handle every plumbing job fast and fairly.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes
services.desc: Water damage spreading? We locate and repair burst pipes the same day, with temporary solutions available within the hour. Includes water damage prevention advice.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Installation
services.desc: Boiler broken down? Most repairs are fixed same day. We also install new gas boilers with 5-year warranties and handle all paperwork for you.

services.title: Leaking Radiators & Valves
services.desc: Radiator dripping or leaking? We diagnose the fault and replace faulty valves, thermostats, or the whole radiator if needed — often in a single visit.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Toilets
services.desc: Blocked sink, toilet, or outside drain? We use CCTV cameras to find the blockage and clear it without digging up your garden or flooring.

services.title: Central Heating System Checks
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your heating running efficiently and safely. We bleed radiators, test pressure, and replace worn parts before winter arrives.

services.title: Tap & Toilet Repairs
services.desc: Dripping taps, running toilets, or faulty washers waste water and money. We replace internal components or fit new taps with modern water-saving designs.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was tired of cowboys overcharging my neighbours.
about_para_1: Armitage Plumbing Solutions has served Bolton and surrounding areas for 18 years. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local team, handling everything from emergency burst pipes to scheduled boiler servicing. We're Gas Safe Registered and carry all parts and tools needed to fix most jobs on the first visit.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up on time, fixing the problem properly, and charging fairly — no hidden fees, no pressure to buy extras you don't need. Repeat customers make up over 60% of our work, because they know we'll treat their home with the same care we'd use on our own.
reviews_heading: What Bolton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a leaking radiator the night before Christmas. Called Armitage at 10pm and Dave came out within the hour. Had it sorted in 45 minutes, fair price, brilliant bloke. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Paul T.

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in during the cold snap. Got an appointment within 24 hours and they diagnosed a faulty pump. Replaced it same day with a full guarantee. Would have cost way more with someone else. Really impressed.
reviews.author: Michelle K.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out for a burst pipe under the kitchen. They came within the hour, isolated the leak, and then came back the next day to replace the damaged section properly. No messing about, no surprise invoices. Honest traders.
reviews.author: Graham M.
